sentences.text: Today in Lisboa, the minimum is 15.9 °C and the maximum is 20.9 °C, with a 100% chance of rain and a moderate wind from the west.
IPMA has a yellow warning for rough sea in the Lisboa district from 2026-11-18 17:19 to 2026-11-19 06:00 local time, and an orange warning from 2026-11-19 06:00 to 12:00 local time.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-19, the minimum is 12.8 °C and the maximum is 18.5 °C, with a 2% chance of rain and a moderate wind from the west.
The sea forecast for the Lisboa coast on 2026-11-19 gives waves of 3.5 to 4 metres from the north-west and a sea temperature of 17.4 to 17.5 °C.
A yellow warning for rough sea follows from 2026-11-19 12:00 to 2026-11-20 09:00 local time.
The Lisbon feed links to 'Web Summit opens in Lisbon with humanoid robots as speakers and a focus on physical AI', a story from portugalglobal.pt, not PrompTugal.news.

The Lisbon feed also links to 'Lisbon drone maker Beyond Vision raises over 28 million euros to speed up AI and swarm technology', from vestbee.com, and 'University of Lisbon builds two AI data centres', from portugalglobal.pt.
